requirementCoverage.statement: Role roots are independent, each root requires two active keys, and every role requires two independent roots.
All role signatures cover one exact canonical metadata digest and a role-specific domain; unknown or cross-role scopes fail closed.
OCI descriptor, DSSE envelope, and TUF-style root/targets/snapshot/timestamp metadata form one monotonic, expiring, consistent distribution input.
Root rotation and compromise recovery require an explicit predecessor, recovery authorization, and atomic next-bundle transition.
Membership, certification, revocation, and abuse inputs never decide Endpoint admission; rejection never mutates local high-water state.
Independent observations with one version and digest are required; conflicting observations expose split view or equivocation and are rejected.
Identity, affiliation, and peer Route chains have genesis, exact successor epochs, immediate predecessor digests, and bounded high-water state.
Successors are fully validated before atomic high-water replacement; arrival order, Station time, directory order, and expiry never choose a fork or reset state.
Discovery, witness, gossip, Station signatures, and Verification Records are bounded authenticated inputs and never continuity or trust authorities.
Station-facing affiliation reveals only randomized identity-bound commitments and finite service statements; full affiliation state remains protected.
Private Routes bind one exact affiliation digest, use asynchronous Handles only, and preserve stable Endpoint identity through migration, rotation, revocation, and recovery.
First contact uses one purpose-scoped single-use Delivery Handle and protected invitation binding; the initial peer state is locally unverified and Station success is not trust.

Continuity-preserving key rotation, explicit revocation, and recovery retain the stable Endpoint identity; continuity failure requires re-pairing, and association claims never merge identities or establish trust.

spec/v1/evidence/identity-bundle.schema..title: Lico Arc bounded Endpoint identity continuity evidence bundle

sources.spec/v1/evidence/runtime.cddl:
; Lico Arc Transferable Evidence Checkpoint v1 runtime grammar.
; Statements and checkpoints are Endpoint-protected in transit. A disclosed
; package is independently verifiable only after deterministic decoding,
; canonical digesting, exact signature-purpose checks, and continuity checks.

evidence-record = transferable-statement / evidence-checkpoint

transferable-statement = {
  0 => uint .le 6,                    ; closed statement kind
  1 => digest256,                     ; Protocol Line
  2 => digest256,                     ; author Endpoint reference
  3 => digest256,                     ; counterparty Endpoint reference
  4 => digest256,                     ; exact signer identity state
  5 => id128,                          ; stable logical Message
  6 => bytes .size (1..262144),       ; peer-visible semantic meaning
  7 => bytes .size (0..262144),       ; exact User Payload bytes
  ? 8 => digest256,                   ; predecessor semantic digest
  ? 9 => id128,                       ; attachment identity
  ? 10 => digest256                    ; complete content digest
}

evidence-checkpoint = {
  0 => digest256,
  1 => digest256,
  2 => digest256,
  3 => digest256,
  4 => [+ digest256],                 ; 1..32 sorted unique digests
  5 => [2 signature, * signature]     ; baseline exactly two, max four line-wide
}

signature = {
  0 => uint .le 1,                    ; Ed25519 or ML-DSA-65
  1 => id128,
  2 => 0,                             ; endpoint-evidence purpose only
  3 => bytes .size (2..8192)
}

identity-continuity-bundle = {
  0 => digest256,                      ; Endpoint identity reference
  1 => [+ identity-state]               ; at most 64 under Protocol Line bounds
}

identity-state = {
  0 => digest256,
  1 => uint,
  2 => digest256 / null,
  3 => [1..4 * identity-key]
}

identity-key = {
  0 => id128,
  1 => 0,                              ; endpoint-evidence purpose
  2 => uint .le 2,                     ; active/revoked/recovery
  3 => digest256
}

id128 = bytes .size 16
digest256 = bytes .size 32
bytes = bstr

; Statement projection excludes session IDs, protection frames, ciphertext,
; retry attempts, Route, Station carriage, timing, and storage handles. The
; statement digest is SHA-256("LP-EVIDENCE-STATEMENT" || NUL separator || canonical CBOR
; projection). Checkpoint signing input is deterministic CBOR prefixed by
; "LP-EVIDENCE-CHECKPOINT" || NUL separator and excludes the signatures member itself.
; The complete statement and checkpoint pair is joined before application
; delivery or peer-visible state advance. Orphans stay bounded pending and
; expire only on an endpoint-local expiry event; time is not authenticated.

sources.spec/v1/foundation/runtime.cddl:
; Lico Arc Protocol v1 foundation runtime subset.
; This is an encoding contract only. Capability-specific semantics allocate
; their own fields after their independent lifecycle decisions.

foundation-runtime-record = {
  0 => uint,
  ? 1 => bstr,
  ? 2 => uint
}

; 0 is a closed record-kind label.  1 is bounded raw protected-packet bytes.
; 2 is a bounded unsigned sequence coordinate.  Text map labels, tags,
; floating-point values, duplicate labels, and indefinite lengths are invalid.

spec/v1/group/group.schema.json.title: Lico Arc Protocol v1 protected Group Collaboration profile

sources.spec/v1/group/runtime.cddl:
; Lico Arc Protocol v1 Group Collaboration runtime profile.
; Labels are compact unsigned integers and all maps/arrays are definite.
; Endpoint protection supplies confidentiality and authentication; this
; profile never delegates state authority to a Station or product permission.

digest256 = bstr .size 32
id128 = bstr .size 16
role = 0 / 1                         ; member / state-authority
operation-kind = 0 / 1 / 2 / 3       ; genesis / add / remove / role
result-outcome = 0 / 1 / 2 / 3        ; pending / delivered / rejected / failed
aggregate-outcome = 0 / 1 / 2         ; complete / partial / failed

group-member = {
  0: digest256,                       ; endpointIdentityRef
  1: role
}

group-state = {
  0: digest256,                       ; groupId
  1: uint,                            ; groupEpoch, <= MAX_GROUP_EPOCH
  ? 2: digest256,                     ; previousGroupStateDigest
  3: [1*64 group-member],             ; members, byte-sorted and unique
  4: digest256                        ; transitionDigest
}

group-operation = {
  0: operation-kind,
  ? 1: digest256,                     ; targetEndpointRef
  ? 2: role,                           ; targetRole
  ? 3: [1*64 group-member]             ; genesis initialMembers
}

group-transition = {
  0: digest256,                       ; groupId
  ? 1: digest256,                     ; previousGroupStateDigest
  2: uint,                            ; nextGroupEpoch
  3: digest256,                       ; authorEndpointRef
  4: group-operation
}

group-message = {
  0: id128,
  1: digest256,                       ; groupStateDigest
  2: bstr .size 0..262144             ; opaque protected payload
}

group-projection = {
  0: id128,
  1: id128,
  2: digest256,
  3: digest256
}

group-result = {
  0: id128,
  1: digest256,
  2: result-outcome,
  ? 3: uint,                          ; closed failure code
  4: 0 / 1                            ; endpoint-evidence / none
}

group-aggregate = {
  0: id128,
  1: digest256,
  2: [1*64 group-result],
  3: aggregate-outcome,
  4: { 0: uint, 1: uint, 2: uint, 3: uint }
}

spec/v1/identity/identity.policy.json.title: Lico Arc Protocol identity and transparency policy

spec/v1/identity/identity.schema.json.title: Lico Arc Protocol v1 identity, discovery, affiliation, route, and transparency records

sources.spec/v1/identity/runtime.cddl:
; Lico Arc Protocol identity line v1 semantic runtime grammar.
; The Protocol Line maps these members to compact unsigned CBOR labels.
; Governance JSON names remain source projections and are never a second wire.

identity-record = identity-update / affiliation-update / route-update /
                  first-contact / discovery-input / transparency-bundle /
                  association-claim

identity-update = {
  record-type: "identityUpdate",
  protocol-line-id: digest256,
  endpoint-identity-ref: digest256,
  identity-epoch: epoch,
  ? previous-identity-state-digest: digest256,
  transition: identity-transition,
  state-digest: digest256,
  key-authorizations: [* key-authorization],
  ? revoked-key-digests: [* digest256],
  ? recovery-proof: recovery-proof,
  continuity-proof: continuity-proof,
  endpoint-signature: signature
}

affiliation-update = {
  record-type: "affiliationUpdate",
  protocol-line-id: digest256,
  endpoint-identity-ref: digest256,
  affiliation-epoch: epoch,
  ? previous-affiliation-update-digest: digest256,
  transition: affiliation-transition,
  station-affiliations: [* station-affiliation],
  state-digest: digest256,
  endpoint-signature: signature
}

route-update = {
  record-type: "routeUpdate",
  protocol-line-id: digest256,
  endpoint-identity-ref: digest256,
  peer-endpoint-identity-ref: digest256,
  route-epoch: epoch,
  ? previous-route-update-digest: digest256,
  transition: route-transition,
  affiliation-state-digest: digest256,
  route-not-after: unix-seconds,
  routes: [* route],
  endpoint-signature: signature
}

first-contact = {
  record-type: "firstContact",
  handle-class: "firstContact",
  delivery-handle: token256,
  audience-digest: digest256,
  invitation-binding: digest256,
  purpose: "firstContact",
  single-use: true,
  expires-at: unix-seconds,
  protected-invitation: protected-invitation,
  peer-verification-state: "unverified"
}

discovery-input = {
  record-type: "discoveryInput",
  input-id: id128,
  source-kind: "directory" / "witness" / "gossip" / "station",
  source-ref: digest256,
  subject-endpoint-identity-ref: digest256,
  chain-kind: "identity" / "affiliation" / "route",
  state-epoch: epoch,
  state-digest: digest256,
  statement-digest: digest256,
  observed-at: unix-seconds,
  expires-at: unix-seconds,
  source-signature: signature,
  ? authenticated-input-only: true
}

transparency-bundle = {
  record-type: "transparencyBundle",
  subject-endpoint-identity-ref: digest256,
  chain-kind: "identity" / "affiliation" / "route",
  state-epoch: epoch,
  state-digest: digest256,
  witness-inputs: [* authenticated-input],
  gossip-inputs: [* authenticated-input],
  discovery-inputs: [* authenticated-input],
  station-signature-inputs: [* authenticated-input],
  verification-inputs: [* authenticated-input],
  authority: "bounded-authenticated-input-only",
  endpoint-retains-continuity: true,
  ? split-view: bool
}

association-claim = {
  record-type: "associationClaim",
  claim-id: id128,
  issuer-endpoint-identity-ref: digest256,
  subject-endpoint-identity-refs: [+ digest256],
  claim-epoch: epoch,
  ? previous-claim-digest: digest256,
  claim-digest: digest256,
  expires-at: unix-seconds,
  authority: "non-authoritative-protected-input",
  issuer-signature: signature
}

station-affiliation = {
  station-descriptor-digest: digest256,
  affiliation-commitment: digest256,
  affiliation-nonce: token256,
  affiliation-not-after: unix-seconds,
  station-affiliation-signature: signature
}

route = {
  station-descriptor-digest: digest256,
  affiliation-commitment: digest256,
  transport-profile-id: digest256,
  handle-class: "async",
  delivery-handle: token256,
  service-until: unix-seconds,
  station-service-signature: signature
}

protected-invitation = {
  inviter-endpoint-identity-ref: digest256,
  ? invitee-endpoint-identity-ref: digest256,
  invitation-binding: digest256,
  purpose: "firstContact",
  audience-digest: digest256,
  ? handshake-nonce: token256
}

authenticated-input = {
  input-id: id128,
  input-kind: "witness" / "gossip" / "discovery" /
              "stationSignature" / "verificationRecord",
  source-ref: digest256,
  state-epoch: epoch,
  state-digest: digest256,
  statement-digest: digest256,
  expires-at: unix-seconds,
  signature: signature,
  ? authenticated-input-only: true
}

key-authorization = {
  key-id: id128,
  key-purpose: "identity" / "evidence" / "handshake",
  key-digest: digest256,
  key-state: "active" / "revoked" / "recovery",
  valid-from-epoch: epoch,
  ? revoked-at-epoch: epoch
}

continuity-proof = {
  proof-kind: "genesis" / "rotation" / "revocation" /
              "recovery" / "migration",
  predecessor-state-digest: digest256 / null,
  signature: signature
}

recovery-proof = {
  recovery-digest: digest256,
  witnesses: [+ signature]
}

signature = {
  key-id: id128,
  signature-purpose: "endpoint-continuity" / "endpoint-evidence" /
                     "station-affiliation" / "station-route-service" /
                     "witness" / "gossip" / "discovery" / "verification",
  signature-value: bytes
}

identity-transition = "genesis" / "rotation" / "revocation" / "recovery"
affiliation-transition = "genesis" / "migration" / "rotation" /
                         "revocation" / "recovery"
route-transition = "genesis" / "migration" / "rotation" /
                   "revocation" / "recovery"
digest256 = bytes .size 32
token256 = bytes .size 32
id128 = bytes .size 16
epoch = uint .between 1 9007199254740991
unix-seconds = uint .between 0 9007199254740991

spec/v1/messaging/control.schema.json.title: Lico Arc Attachment Receive State semantic projection

spec/v1/messaging/message.schema.json.title: Lico Arc Generic Message semantic projection

sources.spec/v1/messaging/runtime.cddl:
; Lico Arc Protocol v1 Generic Messaging and resumable attachments.
; All maps use unsigned integer labels and deterministic definite-length CBOR.
; The comments are normative where CDDL cannot express cross-field arithmetic.

generic-message = {
  0 => bstr,                         ; messageId, exactly 16 octets
  1 => uint,                         ; kind, 0..5
  ? 2 => bstr,                       ; relatesTo, exactly 16 octets when present
  3 => uint,                         ; contentType, uint32
  4 => bstr,                         ; payload, 0..MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES octets
  ? 5 => { * uint => bstr },         ; extensions, bounded application namespace
  ? 6 => [* uint],                   ; critical, bounded and closed in v1
  ? 7 => uint,                       ; chunkIndex, streamChunk only
  ? 8 => bool,                       ; chunkFinal, non-attachment stream only
  ? 9 => bstr,                       ; attachmentId, attachment streamChunk only
  ? 10 => [* attachment-descriptor]
}

attachment-descriptor = {
  0 => bstr,                         ; attachmentId, exactly 16 octets
  1 => uint,                         ; mediaType, uint32
  2 => uint,                         ; byteLength, 0..MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES
  3 => bstr                          ; contentDigest, exactly 32 octets
}

chunk-range = {
  0 => uint,                         ; inclusive startChunkIndex
  1 => uint                          ; exclusive endChunkIndexExclusive
}

attachment-receive-state = {
  0 => bstr,                         ; attachmentId, exactly 16 octets
  1 => [* chunk-range],              ; 0..MAX_REQUEST_RANGES, bounded coverage
  2 => uint,                         ; stateUpdate, starts at zero
  3 => uint,                         ; outcome, 0 pending, 1 complete, 2 cancelled, 3 failed
  ? 4 => uint,                       ; failureCode, required for cancelled/failed
  5 => uint                          ; recoveryRound, starts at zero
}

; Generic Message class values:
;   0 event, 1 request, 2 response, 3 error, 4 cancel, 5 streamChunk.
; Reserved contentType 4294901761 is attachmentReceiveState. It is valid only
; on an event whose payload is exactly attachment-receive-state. All other
; values in 4294901760..4294967295 are unknown reserved meanings and fail.
;
; Per-kind rules:
;   response, error, cancel, streamChunk require relatesTo;
;   streamChunk requires chunkIndex and either attachmentId or chunkFinal;
;   attachment chunks forbid chunkFinal and carry one descriptor-derived slice;
;   non-attachment stream chunks require chunkFinal and forbid attachmentId;
;   receive-state event requires relatesTo and has no attachments field.
;
; Attachment geometry is fixed by the enclosing Protocol Line:
;   count = byteLength == 0 ? 0 : ceil(byteLength / ATTACHMENT_CHUNK_BYTES)
;   offset(i) = i * ATTACHMENT_CHUNK_BYTES
;   length(i) = min(ATTACHMENT_CHUNK_BYTES, byteLength - offset(i)).
; Checked arithmetic and MAX_ATTACHMENT_CHUNKS are applied before allocation.
; The protected tuple (relatesTo, attachmentId, chunkIndex) binds one stable
; messageId and one immutable raw payload slice. A changed identity or bytes is
; terminal. contentDigest covers all slices in ascending index order.
;
; Extension labels must be in 65536..2147483647. Labels in either reserved
; range are rejected. A critical label must occur in extensions and be known by
; this line; v1 recognizes no critical extension, so a non-empty critical array
; is terminal unknown-critical. Unknown non-critical values remain opaque.
;
; Receive-state ranges are half-open, non-empty, strictly ordered, disjoint,
; and non-adjacent. Their count and covered index sum are bounded. Empty ranges
; are legal only after all derived chunks and exact length are accepted and the
; complete contentDigest verifies. Completion, cancellation, and failure are
; absorbing. stateUpdate and recoveryRound cannot decrease or reset; retries,
; reconnects, session renewal, Route changes, and Station migration do not
; refresh any lifetime bound or ATTACHMENT_RECOVERY_WINDOW.

spec/v1/reliable/event.schema.json.title: Lico Arc Reliable Exchange event semantic projection

spec/v1/reliable/intent.schema.json.title: Lico Arc Reliable Exchange Protected Intent semantic projection

sources.spec/v1/reliable/runtime.cddl:
; Lico Arc Reliable Exchange v1 endpoint-protected runtime grammar.
; Every map uses compact unsigned integer labels, deterministic CBOR, shortest
; definite lengths, raw byte strings, no tags/floats/indefinite lengths, and
; rejects unknown labels and trailing bytes before state transition.

reliable-record = reliable-intent / reliable-event / confirmation / state-snapshot

reliable-intent = {
  0 => id128,                         ; stable logical Message identity
  1 => digest256,                     ; Protected Intent digest
  2 => bytes .size (1..256),          ; application idempotency input
  3 => bytes .size (0..262144),       ; exact User Payload bytes
  4 => uint .le 4294967295,           ; opaque application content type
  5 => digest256,                     ; peer-visible meaning digest
  ? 6 => digest256,                   ; complete attachment declaration root
  ? 7 => id128                        ; stable Group projection identity
}

reliable-event = {
  0 => uint .le 11,                   ; closed event kind
  1 => id128,
  2 => digest256,
  ? 3 => uint,                        ; route epoch; never a message identity
  ? 4 => bytes .size (1..524288),     ; exact protected packet when carried
  ? 5 => digest256,
  ? 6 => digest256,                   ; application result digest
  ? 7 => uint .le 12,                 ; closed failure code
  ? 8 => uint .le 3,                  ; Station hint only
  ? 9 => id128,
  ? 10 => digest256,
  ? 11 => id128,
  ? 12 => uint .le 32,
  ? 13 => [* chunk-range],
  ? 14 => [* projection-result]
}

confirmation = {
  0 => id128,                         ; confirmation identity
  1 => uint .le 3,                   ; received/accepted/completed/terminal
  2 => uint .le 4,                   ; pending/success/cancelled/failed/ambiguous
  3 => [+ id128],                     ; sorted unique bounded IDs
  ? 4 => uint .le 12,
  ? 5 => digest256
}

chunk-range = {
  0 => uint,
  1 => uint
}

projection-result = {
  0 => id128,
  1 => digest256,
  2 => uint .le 3,                    ; pending/delivered/rejected/failed
  ? 3 => uint .le 12,
  4 => uint .le 1                      ; endpoint-evidence or none
}

state-snapshot = {
  0 => uint .le 3,                    ; outbox/inbox/attachment/aggregate
  1 => uint .le 11,                   ; tagged state from the selected family
  2 => id128,
  3 => digest256,
  ? 4 => bytes .size (1..256),
  ? 5 => uint,
  ? 6 => digest256,
  ? 7 => uint .le 32,
  ? 8 => uint .le 16,
  9 => uint .le 256,                  ; immutable lifetime transition count
  ? 10 => uint .le 12,
  ? 11 => digest256,
  ? 12 => digest256,
  ? 13 => id128,
  ? 14 => uint .le 32,
  ? 15 => uint .le 64,
  ? 16 => [* chunk-range],
  ? 17 => [* projection-result],
  ? 18 => digest256
}

id128 = bytes .size 16
digest256 = bytes .size 32
bytes = bstr

; Event validation is atomic: intent identity, digest, route epoch, exact
; packet identity, evidence digest, and all caller-provided bounds are checked
; together.  Same logical identity plus different meaning is terminal
; conflict. Retry, restart, session renewal, Route change, Station migration,
; and replay do not reset transition, retry, confirmation, or recovery bounds.
; A Station outcome is never enough to cross Endpoint Accepted or Effect
; Completed. A terminal state accepts only an identical replay/ack and rejects
; all reopen attempts.

spec/v1/reliable/state.schema.json.title: Lico Arc Reliable Exchange serializable tagged state

storage.claim: one bounded live claim per returned item and fixed claim window
storage.retention: one fixed storage window from accepted submission
storage.settlement: complete or release atomically for the complete requested set

spec/v1/transport/request.schema.json.title: Lico Arc HTTPS Transport v1 control requests

spec/v1/transport/response.schema.json.title: Lico Arc HTTPS Transport v1 control responses

sources.spec/v1/transport/runtime.cddl:
; Lico Arc HTTPS Transport v1 runtime grammar.
; The carrier is HTTP/2 over TLS 1.3 only. Control bodies are one
; deterministic CBOR map with compact unsigned labels. SUBMIT carries exactly
; one raw protected packet body. An accepted RETRIEVE response carries exactly
; one raw protected packet body. No JSON envelope, tags, floats, indefinite
; lengths, duplicate labels, unknown labels, or trailing bytes exist.
;
; LicoArc-Operation-Id is a required lowercase 16-byte ID128 encoded as 32
; hexadecimal characters in a header. It is not a CBOR label. The request
; target uses one unpadded base64url TOKEN256 only for handle-bound operations.

control-request = affiliate-request / reserve-request / retrieve-request /
                  claim-request / settle-request

affiliate-request = {
  0 => digest256,                         ; Station descriptor digest
  1 => digest256                          ; opaque affiliation commitment
}

reserve-request = {
  0 => digest256,                         ; Station descriptor digest
  1 => digest256,                         ; opaque affiliation commitment
  2 => digest256,                         ; exact Transport Profile digest
  3 => uint .le 1                         ; async=0, firstContact=1
}

retrieve-request = {
  0 => token256,                          ; live claim id
  1 => uint,                              ; live claim epoch
  2 => token256                           ; Station-local item id
}

claim-request = {
  0 => uint .between 1 64                 ; requested item bound
}

settle-request = {
  0 => token256,                          ; live claim id
  1 => uint,                              ; live claim epoch
  2 => [+ settlement]                     ; complete bounded set
}

settlement = {
  0 => token256,                          ; Station-local item id
  1 => uint .le 1                         ; complete=0, release=1
}

control-response = affiliate-response / reserve-response / submit-response /
                   claim-response / settle-response

affiliate-response = {
  0 => uint .le 3,                        ; accepted/rejected/transient/ambiguous
  ? 1 => uint,                            ; affiliationNotAfter
  ? 2 => signature,                       ; Station service statement only
  ? 3 => uint .le 7,                      ; failure class
  ? 4 => uint .le 60000                   ; retryAfterMs
}

reserve-response = {
  0 => uint .le 3,
  ? 1 => token256,                        ; one opaque Delivery Handle
  ? 2 => uint .le 1,                      ; async/firstContact
  ? 3 => uint,                            ; finite serviceUntil
  ? 4 => signature,                        ; async Route capability only
  ? 5 => uint .le 7,
  ? 6 => uint .le 60000
}

submit-response = {
  0 => uint .le 3,
  ? 1 => uint .le 7,
  ? 2 => uint .le 60000
}

claim-response = {
  0 => uint .le 3,
  ? 1 => token256,                         ; claim id when items are returned
  ? 2 => uint,                              ; claim epoch when items are returned
  ? 3 => [+ claimed-item],                  ; bounded packet batch
  ? 4 => uint .le 7,
  ? 5 => uint .le 60000
}

claimed-item = {
  0 => token256,
  1 => bytes .size (1..524288)
}

settle-response = {
  0 => uint .le 3,
  ? 1 => [+ settlement-result],
  ? 2 => uint .le 7,
  ? 3 => uint .le 60000
}

settlement-result = {
  0 => token256,
  1 => uint .le 3                       ; completed/released/stale/attemptLimit
}

digest256 = bytes .size 32
token256 = bytes .size 32
signature = bytes .size 64
bytes = bstr

; A malformed carrier fails before any operation state changes: wrong TLS or
; HTTP version, invalid name, wrong method/path/media type, query/fragment,
; missing or mismatched Content-Length, transfer encoding, trailers,
; content-encoding, empty/oversized packet, non-canonical CBOR, duplicate or
; unknown label, omitted required label, invalid token/enum, duplicate item,
; or settlement outside the fixed claim is rejected. A Station cannot create
; Endpoint acceptance, effect completion, freshness, replay, trust, or proof
; of deletion by returning any outcome, signature, timestamp, or queue signal.
